question: Where and how should the air be drawn and drunk?
premises: One places the air at the root of the tongue and palate.
Having made that placement, one should drink the air.
This is to be done slowly.
inference: Having placed the air at the root of the tongue and palate, one should drink it slowly.
uncertainties: Purpose of this practice not stated
plain_english: Having placed the air at the root of the tongue and palate, one should drink it slowly.
